items.t: Camshaft position sensor can melt and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor and add fuse
items.note: Daewoo's US dealers have closed, so a shop may charge for this if the recall can't be done.

items.t: Timing belt or tensioner fails and bends valves
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler pulleys
items.note: Estimate based on the closely related Chevrolet Aveo 1.6L. If valves are already bent, owners of that car report repairs around $2,500.
Estimate based on the related Chevrolet Aveo. One Lanos owner paid $660 for a water pump and heater hose; an engine ruined by overheating cost about $2,000.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off without warning
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace sensor or engine computer
items.note: A position sensor is at the low end. One owner paid about $1,500 for a water-damaged engine computer.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling when cold
items.job: Clean EGR valve and throttle body, replace fuel filter
items.note: Owners report cleaning the EGR valve and replacing only its gasket for a few dollars.

items.t: Brakes wear quickly, grind or calipers stick
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Estimate based on the related Chevrolet Aveo. A seized caliper adds to the cost.

items.t: Brake lights stop working from a failed switch

items.note: Estimate based on a mount replacement on the related Chevrolet Aveo.
